memoryRule: a traveled drag moves one cut-out into a wrong occupied slot, leaves its source slot vacant, and files the displaced occupant in the margin rail
interactionRule: pointer movement and short taps are refused; a drag beyond the threshold, Enter, Space, or the misfile control commit one bounded slot reflow; Delete lifts the latest misfile; release clears the picture
representationRupture: continuous weather panorama, pressure print sheet, and SVG room map -> browser-native DOM cut-outs whose actual slot occupancy drives the picture
encounterRupture: wheel, button pressure, and proximity plus click -> a traveled drag that must cross space before a wrong address can commit
temporalRupture: horizon tilt, pressure register, and opening/closure topology -> bounded document reflow with a visible vacancy and margin archive
mediumRupture: p5 Canvas and inline SVG geometry -> deterministic HTML/CSS layout and pointer capture
promotion: candidate / held pending browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
